name: Blue Ghost Mission 1
summary: Blue Ghost Mission 1 was a commercial lunar lander flying payloads for NASA.
hook: I delivered ten NASA payloads to Mare Crisium under the Commercial Lunar Payload Services initiative.
how_it_worked: Used autonomous thruster guidance to land in Mare Crisium and powered science instruments through the lunar day.
science: Investigated lunar regolith characteristics and tested GPS signal reception at lunar distance.

facts.text: Blue Ghost was selected under NASA Commercial Lunar Payload Services to deliver science payloads.
Completed operations across a full 14-day lunar daylight period in Mare Crisium.

image.alt: SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket carrying Firefly Aerospace Blue Ghost Mission 1 at Launch Complex 39A before launch to the Moon
